reply: [{"query": "根据 GVP Module VII，若上市许可持有人（MAH）逾期提交 PSUR，具体应处以多少金额的罚款（fine）？", "query_en": "According to GVP Module VII, what is the specific fine amount imposed on a marketing authorisation holder for late submission of a PSUR?", "topic": "PSUR逾期罚款金额", "absence_terms": ["fine", "penalty", "financial penalty", "罚款"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 5, "text": "Each marketing authorisation holder shall be responsible for submitting PSURs for its own products [DIR Art 107b] [REG Art 28 (2)] and should submit PSURs to the Agency (see VII.C.9. for transitional arrangements) according to the following timelines:"}, "rationale": "该指南只规定了PSUR的提交时限（70/90个日历日），是行为规范类guideline，不涉及具体罚款金额，此类财务处罚属于各成员国执法法律范畴，不在本文件覆盖范围内。"}, {"query": "根据 GVP Module VII，MAH 在 EU 单一评估（single assessment）程序中需要向 EMA 支付多少评估费用（fee）？", "query_en": "According to GVP Module VII, what fee must a marketing authorisation holder pay to the EMA for the EU single assessment procedure of a PSUR?", "topic": "EU单一评估程序费用", "absence_terms": ["fee", "cost recovery", "invoice", "费用"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 53, "text": "Following receipt of comments, the PRAC Rapporteur/Member State shall prepare an updated assessment report [DIR Art 107e (3)] within 15 days (i.e. by Day 105)."}, "rationale": "文件详细描述了EU单一评估的程序时限与角色分工，但作为程序性guideline，从未提及需缴纳的评估费用金额，此类费用由独立的EMA收费法规规定，不属本文件内容。"}]
